newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LAMAISON CITED BY SCOTS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LAMAISON CITED BY SCOTS.

text.p: The Scottish Rugby Union (SRU) have cited French centre Christophe Lamaison for the tackle which knocked fly-half Craig Chalmers unconscious in the 47-20 Five Nations defeat in Paris on Saturday.
Chalmers had to be taken to hospital after being stretchered off Parc des Princes early in the second-half although he was well enough to fly home to Scotland on Sunday.
Lamaison, who scored 24 points to help his side secure their first grand slam on home soil, could be handed a suspension but insists there was no malice in his actions.
"The tackle was a tough one but I don't think I committed any offence," said the Brive centre.
